candidates.description: This vector represents names of U.S. states and related geographic entities.
This vector represents historical American figures, particularly founding fathers, generals, and statesmen from the Revolutionary War and early American eras.
These tokens represent numerical values that typically correspond to measurements, quantities, or data points.
This feature vector activates on tokens containing specific Latin-derived suffixes or word endings featuring "era", "erra", and related morphological patterns.
This vector represents standard Latin or French prefixes and root morphemes, particularly those denoting negation or inversion.
The feature represents linguistic roots, suffixes, or stems common to various descriptive adjectives, verbs, and abstract nouns.
This feature vector represents common concrete nouns across multiple languages, primarily in Italian and French.
This vector represents major cities, geographic locations, and prominent urban centers.
This feature vector activates on terms related to the Canadian province of Quebec, its municipalities, and regional governance.
This vector activates on prefixes, roots, and proper nouns containing recurring linguistic fragments related to measurement, size, or specific etymological stems.
